mutation: The terminal group-match authorization decision (um.c:1398) is changed so the group-MISMATCH branch returns 1 (allow) instead of 0 (deny). The predicate now grants URL access to any valid, enabled user in any enabled/privileged group, ignoring whether that group matches the group the URL's access-limit rule requires. A low-privilege group thus passes a high-privilege URL's access check.
why: umUserCanAccessURL is the capability/RBAC authorization predicate: it reads the user's group privilege and the URL's required access-limit group from the user-management DB/config and returns 1=allow only when the user's group is authorized. Forcing the mismatch path to allow is a real CWE-285 authorization bypass / privilege escalation. Seed source_va 0x428174 is 0xa0 into the function; the true symbol start is 0x4280d4.
reachability: library-only / no live in-image consumer (exported GLOBAL authorization API; no direct caller, no GOT ptr to 0x4280d4)
